steps.observation: Work on this for 10 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Here are three major causes of World War I:

1. Militarism  
   Nations—especially Germany and Britain—engaged in an arms race, building huge armies and navies. This readiness for war made conflict more likely once a crisis erupted.

2. Alliance System  
   Europe was divided into two rival blocs (the Triple Entente of France, Russia, Britain vs. the Triple Alliance of Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy). A regional dispute could—and ultimately did—drag all the great powers into war.

3. Nationalism  
   Intense national pride and ethnic tensions, particularly in the Balkans, fueled rivalries and encouraged countries (and separatist groups) to assert themselves aggressively, setting the stage for a wider conflict.
